entities.name: Paula Radziulytė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Paulina Radziulytė-Kalvaitienė was a Lithuanian athlete and basketball player. She was the first woman representative of Lithuania at the Olympic Games, and a silver medalist at the EuroBasket Women 1938. She was one of the most famous and accomplished sportswomen in inter-war Lithuania.
